summary:
ACCEPTED design (PR #794, merged at a4c75efa; Root's merge comment carries three implementation notes). The implementation for FS.GG.Game#789 (Outcome .github#5218) is IN REVIEW, not merged. The ADR docs/roadmaps/game-render-02-glyphs.md is canonical, and this record indexes it.

**Decisions (accepted):**
- **Glyphs** are compositional on the APP-6 slot model. GlyphSpec, Glyph, GlyphDrawing, GlyphFamily, IconRef, ModifierRef, AmplifierSlot and Amplifier are opaque with builders, so #795's Symbology targets them.
- **Hit bounds** (GlyphDrawing.frame) are the frame's drawn box, independent of state. At a nominal 24: Own and Ally 24x16, Neutral 24x24, Enemy 20x20, Unknown 30x30. GlyphDrawing.extent adds the 8-unit cue reserve and the amplifiers.
- **Identity frames** are fixed by the library and built from bars on whole units: Own rectangle, Ally with true quarter-point holes, Neutral square, stepped diamond, stepped quatrefoil. Their minimum size is 12. With the kit's corner and quarter-edge samples (ScenePixels.identityExpectations), every pair differs; the D1 matrix (Own/Ally 4, Ally/Enemy 24/40/54/93 at 12/16/24/32) is reproduced exactly.
- **Passes:** all amplifiers, then all bodies, then all brackets, then cues. In each body the order is frame, team mark, icon, modifiers, and the **team badge LAST**. No amplifier covers a frame or a badge.
- **Team mark (review errata):**
  - **E1:** a unit's mark is frame, then a body-colour keyline, then a team-colour ring, then the body, so the ring touches only the body. The first baked classic set team colours equal to allegiance colours (1.00:1 ring against the frame); the keyline makes this moot for every preset.
  - **E6:** a structure's mark is an inner foot band (the ring's lower rows), so a unit and a structure with the same identity, size and badge still differ.
  - Marks are clipped to the frame's own bars, so they never fill Ally's holes.
- **Team badge:** mandatory when the game's teams share an allegiance, drawn inside the frame at the centre.
  - The minimum frame for one digit is 22 (Neutral 12, Unknown 16, Own 18, Enemy 20, Ally 22).
  - **Two digits:** the minimum frame is 33 (Own 18, Neutral 16, Unknown 24, Enemy 28, Ally 33).
  - **Team numbers never wrap.** Below the minimum the badge is omitted with a diagnostic.
  - While a mandatory badge occupies a 22-39 unit frame, the **icon slot is unavailable**. Glyphs.iconSlotAvailable lets #795's builder fail at build time. From 40 units the icon and badge sit side by side.
- **Focus tones (E2):** the outer tone is whichever contrasts with the ground.
- **Cue layer:** Glyphs.cues and cuesHover have the type `(unit -> Theme) -> CueContext -> SceneNode list` and read the theme on each draw. The focus bands are at least 2 CSS px, and hover is opt-in.
- **Tokens and ownership (Root's ruling):** #789 owns the Theme type; #795's algorithms, presets and checks produce it through its public builders, never a rival type. The layers are seed (ThemeSeed, a closed set of names), map (ThemeAlgorithm, seed -> map -> map) and a closed set of 40 aliases, including status.keyline and glyph.modifier for #795. Players use only Theme.withTeamColour, and the floors (contrastTarget, minCssPerUnit, hueCapacity.*) cannot be overridden (E4). Theme.create returns the theme or every violation: opaque only, a contrastTarget floor of at least 3:1 on the ground, and 3:1 between colours that touch. ThemeCheck.create name (Theme -> ThemeViolation list) adds checks through Theme.validate (#795's ΔE2000 and CVD checks); the theme carries them, so withOverrides reruns them. Algorithm parameters are closures, and DTCG records only algorithm names. Theme.classic is baked and checked against a fresh derivation. It is a PROVISIONAL stand-in: Root's revised ruling makes #795's derivation the source of truth for every preset, classic included. Its team colours are distinct from every allegiance colour (OKLab distance at least 0.069). DTCG import prefers hex, follows {path} references and inherits group $type; export carries numberOverrides; sizes are re-derived from the seed. The resolver document has version 2025-10-01, a date, by Root's ruling: the spec says 2025-10-01 in its table and 2025-11-01 in §4.1.2 (E5). There is also CSS and hex export.
- **Colour:** OKLCH in F#, clamp then Floor(v+0.5), contrast through a committed 256-entry table, cbrt via Pow (Fable has no Math.Cbrt). A probe compares .NET, Node and Windows .NET against a committed expected.txt; the full 16.7M round trip has 0 failures.
- **Kit glyph section** (GlyphConformance.cases):
  - the starter set against a swapped theme;
  - 20+20 identity pairs and 90 digit pairs (0-9);
  - box edges;
  - the dense board against its bodies-first control;
  - the A-B-A switch with cues;
  - monochrome team badges;
  - a visible ring (E1);
  - unit against structure (E6).
- **Drawn controls** are presented and waited for until they show their own pixels, then must differ by the modelled count (at least 59 for the dense board), so a stale frame cannot pass a control.
- **Bounded unmodelled nodes:** a stroked, path, image or clip node undecides only its bounds plus its stroke reach. Text stays unbounded.

**Lessons:**
- Quantise with clamp then Floor(v+0.5).
- Kit controls must be read with an analytic decider at any pixel, not only at the subject's own samples.
- A nested mark must be clipped to the frame's bars, or it paints into Ally's holes.
- A control read must wait for the control's own pixels.

**Held:**
- #786 (unlit Babylon; until then the kit keeps the 0.75 factor);
- #773 (the ring, band and polygon models and the stroked profile);
- Rendering#1504 (Fable Scene constructors);
- sprites (D5);
- #795 (encoding grammar and presets);
- release, then template and RuneScape adoption.

**Not established:** merged source, publication, consumer adoption.
title: GAME-RENDER-02.4 shared glyph and symbology layer with theme tokens (accepted ADR; implementation in review)
